normal.name: schamspeare
normal.text: When I read that there are between six and eight new card sets a year, I just thought, how is this sustainable? But then I read that they also cycle as many older sets out. Okay, so it’s rigged both ways. The cards you bought are phased out, and there is a constant churn of new ones you have to buy to stay competitive. And with each new set, some new IP is introduced, watering down whatever was inherently Magic in Magic the Gathering. (7) #MTG #MTGArena #games
